You are the CEO of TerraFirm REIT. It's mid-December 2022 and you just received the final appraisals for each of the 12 office properties in your portfolio:

| Property        | YE 2022 Appraised Book Value |
|-----------------|------------------------------|
| Prince          | $211,000,000                 |
| Capitol         | $156,000,000                 |
| Governor's Mall | $190,000,000                 |
| Trumball        | $33,500,000                  |
| Jax             | $292,000,000                 |
| CenterSquare    | $101,000,000                 |
| Sunnyside       | $63,500,000                  |
| Boardwalk       | $103,000,000                 |

| Stockton        | $290,000,000                 |
| Phillips        | $210,000,000                 |

| Total Value     | $1,947,000,000               |

Your fund docs and the regulatory regime require a new appraisal round to be conducted in the first half of 2023 such that you will have to update the values of your portfolio effective June 30 2023.

You've run the numbers - and based on various property-level happenings combined with the broader macro environment - your June 30 2023 appraisal cycle is likely to result in a portfolio level decline of $525,435,000, or -27%, and leave you with a portfolio value of $1,421,565,000.

| CenterSquare    | $101,000,000                 | 55%       | $55,550,000     | $45,450,000     |

| Stockton        | $290,000,000                 | 19%       | $55,100,000     | $234,900,000    |
| Phillips        | $210,000,000                 | 27.5%     | $57,750,000     | $152,250,000    |
| Chambers        | $205,000,000                 | 23%       | $47,150,000     | $157,850,000    |
| Total Value     | $1,947,000,000               | 27%       | $525,435,000    | $1,421,565,000  |

Unfortunately, your fund level borrowings are $1,421,310,000.

This new round of appraisals will wipe out all but $255,000 of your fund's equity.

You decide that you need to be proactive and do so ASAP so to avoid this adverse outcome and tripping debt covenants.

Your debt covenants and fund docs require:
- The fund's leverage remain below 85% LTV, based on the portfolio at June 30, 2023

- You must always own at least one of Prince or CenterSquare
- You must always own at least one of Phillips or Chambers
- You must own no less than 5 properties in the fund
